{
  "sections": {
    "purpose_and_use": {
      "text": "Application PD scorecard (RCS-APP-02) estimating 12-month probability of default for unsecured personal loan applications. It is a high-tier model owned by Retail Credit Risk Modelling. The code header states the data is the public UCI German Credit set, used as a stand-in for the bank's application data, so the files provided do not show the model running on real bank data. Output is a PD and a points score per application.",
      "confidence": "high",
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "Purpose    : Probability of default (12m) for unsecured personal loan applications", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
        {"quote": "Owner      : Retail Credit Risk Modelling", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
        {"quote": "public UCI German Credit,", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"}
      ]
    },
    "data": {
      "text": "Reads data/processed/german_credit_train.csv and german_credit_test.csv (public UCI German Credit, stand-in for bank data). Target is 'bad' (1 = default). Reference metrics show train n=700 and test n=300, each with a bad rate of 0.30, consistent with a 70/30 split of 1,000 records. How the split was made (method, seed, stratification) is not in the provided code; the split is done upstream. Excluded from candidates: id, the target, and protected attributes personal_status_sex, sex, age_group, foreign_worker. All other columns are candidate predictors. Observation window, default definition and the 12-month outcome window are not documented.",
      "confidence": "high",
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "EXCLUDED    <- c(\"id\", TARGET, \"personal_status_sex\", \"sex\", \"age_group\", \"foreign_worker\")", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
        {"quote": "\"n\": 700,", "source": "artifacts/reference/credit_scorecard/metrics.json"},
        {"quote": "\"n\": 300,", "source": "artifacts/reference/credit_scorecard/metrics.json"},
        {"quote": "Logistic regression of bad (1 = default)", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"}
      ]
    },
    "methodology": {
      "text": "Weight-of-evidence binning followed by logistic regression, scaled to points. (1) Numeric variables with more than 10 distinct values are cut into 5 quantile bins (type 7, breaks from training data, outer breaks -Inf/Inf); other variables are categorical with one bin per level. (2) WoE per bin = ln(((n_good+0.5)/total_good)/((n_bad+0.5)/total_bad)), with the same 0.5 smoothing in IV. (3) Variables with IV >= 0.02 are retained; protected attributes are excluded from the candidate set. (4) Logistic regression (glm, binomial) of bad on the WoE-transformed selected variables. (5) Score = offset + factor * ln(odds_good), with PDO 20, base score 600 at good:bad odds 50:1, so factor = 20/ln2 and offset = 600 - factor*ln(50). 14 variables were selected in the reference run. CODE VS DOCUMENTATION: the 2019 methodology note describes four characteristics, 4 bins each, dummy-coded logistic regression, and scaling to 500 points at 20:1 odds with 25 PDO. The code does not match any of this, so the note is outdated and the code is taken as authoritative.",
      "confidence": "high",
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "Variables with IV >= 0.02 are kept. Protected attributes are never candidates.", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
        {"quote": "Score = offset + factor * ln(odds_good), PDO 20, 600 points at good:bad odds 50:1.", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
        {"quote": "fit <- glm(train[[TARGET]] ~ ., data = X_train, family = binomial())", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
        {"quote": "The model is a logistic regression on dummy-coded bins. Scores are scaled to 500 points", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/methodology_note_2019.txt"}
      ]
    },
    "implementation": {
      "text": "Single R script (reference run on R 4.1.2) using only the jsonlite package; AUC, KS and Gini are hand-coded. set.seed(42) is set, although no step in the script uses random numbers. Run with: Rscript models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R [data_dir] [out_dir], defaulting to data/processed and artifacts/reference/credit_scorecard. Outputs: bins.csv (bin-level WoE and IV), coefficients.csv (estimates and standard errors), predictions_test.csv (id, bad, pd, score), and metrics.json (parameters, selected variables, breaks and metrics). No scoring-only or production deployment code is provided.",
      "confidence": "high",
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "Usage: Rscript models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R [data_dir] [out_dir]", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
        {"quote": "suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(jsonlite))", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
        {"quote": "\"r_version\": \"4.1.2\",", "source": "artifacts/reference/credit_scorecard/metrics.json"},
        {"quote": "set.seed(42)", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"}
      ]
    },
    "performance": {
      "text": "Reference outputs: train AUC 0.8171, Gini 0.6341, KS 0.4952 (n=700); test AUC 0.8010, Gini 0.6019, KS 0.5063 (n=300). Bad rate is 0.30 in both samples. The small train-to-test AUC drop (about 0.016) gives no sign of material overfitting on this sample. The reference outputs do not include calibration, stability (PSI), out-of-time, segment-level or fairness testing, and the test set is a hold-out, not out-of-time data. Reported figures are from the code's own calculation, not from independent validation.",
      "confidence": "high",
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "\"auc\": 0.800952380952381,", "source": "artifacts/reference/credit_scorecard/metrics.json"},
        {"quote": "\"gini\": 0.601904761904762,", "source": "artifacts/reference/credit_scorecard/metrics.json"},
        {"quote": "\"ks\": 0.506349206349206", "source": "artifacts/reference/credit_scorecard/metrics.json"},
        {"quote": "\"auc\": 0.817060252672498,", "source": "artifacts/reference/credit_scorecard/metrics.json"}
      ]
    },
    "monitoring_and_governance": {
      "text": "Owner is Retail Credit Risk Modelling. Developed 2019; last validated 2021-03-15. The inventory classifies the model as high risk tier, which requires validation every 12 months, so validation is about 68 months overdue. Documentation is flagged as outdated: the methodology note dates from June 2019 (about 89 months old against a 24-month limit) and contradicts the code on variables, binning, model form and score scaling. No monitoring, PSI, back-testing, recalibration or change log is present in the material provided.",
      "confidence": "medium",
      "evidence": [
        {"quote": "Developed  : 2019   Last validated: 2021-03-15", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
        {"quote": "Last independent validation: March 2021 (internal model validation team).", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/methodology_note_2019.txt"},
        {"quote": "RCS-APP-02 Retail Application Scorecard - Methodology note (version 1.0, June 2019)", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/methodology_note_2019.txt"}
      ]
    }
  },

    {"name": "checking_status", "role": "input", "description": "Selected predictor (checking account status; meaning inferred from name, no data dictionary provided).", "transformation": "Categorical bins -> WoE (woe_checking_status).", "evidence": "\"woe_checking_status\",-0.76448489500557", "source": "artifacts/reference/credit_scorecard/coefficients.csv"},
    {"name": "duration", "role": "input", "description": "Selected predictor (loan duration, inferred from name).", "transformation": "5 quantile bins with breaks -Inf, 12, 15, 24, 30, Inf -> WoE.", "evidence": "\"duration\": [\"-Inf\", 12, 15, 24, 30, \"Inf\"]", "source": "artifacts/reference/credit_scorecard/metrics.json"},
    {"name": "credit_history", "role": "input", "description": "Selected predictor (credit history, inferred from name).", "transformation": "Categorical bins -> WoE.", "evidence": "\"woe_credit_history\",-0.676549952777233", "source": "artifacts/reference/credit_scorecard/coefficients.csv"},

  "transformations": [
    {"step": "Candidate selection", "description": "Candidates are all columns of the training data except id, bad, personal_status_sex, sex, age_group and foreign_worker.", "evidence": "CANDIDATES  <- setdiff(names(train), EXCLUDED)", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
    {"step": "Binning", "description": "Numeric variables with more than 10 distinct values are cut into 5 quantile bins (type 7) from training data with outer breaks set to -Inf/Inf and right-closed intervals; all other variables use one bin per level.", "evidence": "is_binned_numeric <- function(x) is.numeric(x) && length(unique(x)) > 10", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
    {"step": "WoE and IV", "description": "WoE = ln(((n_good+0.5)/total_good)/((n_bad+0.5)/total_bad)) per bin; IV is the sum of (dist_good - dist_bad)*WoE.", "evidence": "dist_good <- (n_good + 0.5) / total_good", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
    {"step": "IV-based variable selection", "description": "Variables with IV >= 0.02 are kept; 14 were selected in the reference run.", "evidence": "selected <- names(iv)[iv >= IV_MIN]", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
    {"step": "WoE substitution", "description": "Each selected variable is replaced by the WoE of its bin; levels unseen in training receive WoE 0 (neutral).", "evidence": "w[is.na(w)] <- 0  # level not seen in training: neutral WoE", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
    {"step": "Logistic regression", "description": "glm binomial of bad on the WoE-transformed selected variables; PD is the predicted response probability.", "evidence": "fit <- glm(train[[TARGET]] ~ ., data = X_train, family = binomial())", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
    {"step": "Points scaling", "description": "factor = PDO/ln(2) with PDO=20; offset = 600 - factor*ln(50); score = offset + factor*ln((1-pd)/pd).", "evidence": "to_score   <- function(pd) offset_pts + factor_pts * log((1 - pd) / pd)", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"}
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    {"text": "Quantile breaks and WoE/IV values estimated on the training data are assumed to remain valid for new applications.", "confidence": "medium", "evidence": "breaks from the training data, outer breaks set to -Inf/Inf", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
    {"text": "Categories unseen in training are assumed neutral (WoE 0).", "confidence": "high", "evidence": "w[is.na(w)] <- 0  # level not seen in training: neutral WoE", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
    {"text": "A 0.5 additive smoothing is assumed adequate to avoid zero-count bins in WoE.", "confidence": "high", "evidence": "dist_good <- (n_good + 0.5) / total_good", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
    {"text": "IV >= 0.02 is assumed an appropriate selection threshold; no correlation or multicollinearity screening is applied.", "confidence": "medium", "evidence": "IV_MIN      <- 0.02", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"},
    {"text": "A linear logistic relationship on WoE values is assumed; no interaction terms are included.", "confidence": "medium", "evidence": "fit <- glm(train[[TARGET]] ~ ., data = X_train, family = binomial())", "source": "models/credit_scorecard/scorecard.R"}
